title: Embedding model setup
action: Construct the (CrCl6)3− and (CrBr6)3− clusters embedded in AIMP representations of Cs2NaYCl6 and Cs2NaYBr6. Download the AIMP potentials and build the embedding with >400 AIMP model potentials plus Madelung point charges. Assign basis sets and place Na ghost functions.
description: Required process step to set up the embedded cluster models for subsequent calculations. No scored artifact.

title: CASSCF geometry optimisations and structural properties
action: Perform CASSCF geometry optimisations (active space: 3 electrons in Cr 3d) on the 4A2g, 4T2g (Oh and D4h Jahn‑Teller), 2Eg, and 4T1ga states for both clusters. Output all bond distances, frequencies, and E_JT in structural_results.json.
description: All calculated structural parameters (Å, cm‑1) for both chloride and bromide clusters.

title: ACPF vertical transition energies
action: Run ACPF‑15 calculations at the optimised geometries to compute vertical absorption and emission energies, Stokes shift, and MD origin. Apply empirical correlation corrections. Output in spectroscopic_results.json.
description: Vertical absorption/emission energies, Stokes shift, MD origin (cm‑1) for both clusters after corrections.
